description: Same-binary physical-peer diagnostic of the legacy typed-attention arm cache, with direct CUDA status tracing. Not a speed or production qualification result.
method: Each case ran in a separate process using the same exact diagnostic binary with adaptive attention unset and CUDA call tracing enabled. The per-device cases set the diagnostic-only FIFI_DIAG_P2P_ARM_PER_DEVICE=1; the process-wide case leaves it unset. Passing fixtures compare the final-token greedy winner and best/runner-up logits to a repeated per-token control for one chunk and for two chunks plus an eager tail.
